identity.name: IceSakeRP-7b (IceSakeV12)
identity.summary: A merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card only states it is a merge of pre-trained models via SLERP and lists merged models, with no reported design details, training/evaluation documentation, or inner-workings information.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card says the checkpoint is a merge of pre-trained language models but provides no traceability of the underlying training data, ownership, or usage terms for the merged components.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: The card specifies only text-to-text modality and open-weight access, with no intended-use or deployment context, so downstream uses and associated risks are undefined.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card gives no information about how the training data for the merged base models was collected, curated, or used, only naming the merged models.

possible_risks.description: Terms of service, licenses, or other rules restrict the use of certain models.
possible_risks.justification: The checkpoint is released under cc-by-nc-4.0, which restricts commercial use, so usage rights are explicitly restricted.
